The '''2026 [[MTV Video Music Awards]]''' were held at the [[Peacock Theater]] in [[Los Angeles]], [[California]], on September 27, 2026.<ref>{{Cite magazine |title=Destination Moon (Man): MTV Video Music Awards Head for La-La Land |url=https://www.hitsdailydouble.com/news/awards/vmas-coming-los-angeles-teaser-2026-08-14 |access-date=August 18, 2026 |magazine=[[Hits (magazine)|Hits]]|date=August 14, 2026}}</ref> It was broadcast live on [[CBS]], streamed on [[Paramount+]]'s premium tier and simulcast on [[MTV]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=August 18, 2026 |title=Madonna leads 2026 MTV Video Music Awards nominations, followed by Taylor Swift |url=https://apnews.com/article/2026-mtv-vma-nominations-e9ac1be3adfd613c3bc348e83543832e |access-date=August 18, 2026 |publisher=[[Associated Press]]|last=Sherman|first=Maria}}</ref> The show was hosted by rapper [[Snoop Dogg]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Knapp |first=J. D. |date=September 10, 2026 |title=Snoop Dogg to Host 2026 MTV Video Music Awards |url=https://www.thewrap.com/creative-content/music/snoop-dogg-mtv-vmas-host-2026/ |access-date=September 10, 2026 |website=[[TheWrap]]}}</ref>

The ceremony recognized outstanding [[music video]]s and songs released between June 20, 2025, to June 18, 2026.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Olson |first=Samantha |date=August 18, 2026 |title=The Biggest 2026 VMAs Snubs, From Olivia Rodrigo to BTS |url=https://www.cosmopolitan.com/entertainment/celebs/a73464424/2026-vmas-snubs/ |access-date=September 26, 2026 |website=[[Cosmopolitan (magazine)|Cosmopolitan]]}}</ref> [[Madonna]] was the most nominated and awarded artist, winning seven trophies out of thirteen nominations. [[Taylor Swift]]'s "[[The Fate of Ophelia]]" won [[MTV Video Music Award for Video of the Year|Video of the Year]]. [[Nirvana (band)|Nirvana]] was honored with the [[Michael Jackson Video Vanguard Award|Video Vanguard Award]], and Swift with the inaugural MTV VMA Artist Director Honor. The music video for Swift's song "[[Patient Zero (song)|Patient Zero]]" premiered during the broadcast.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Sundby |first=Alex |date=September 24, 2026 |title=Taylor Swift to debut "Patient Zero" music video at Sunday's VMAs |url=https://www.cbsnews.com/news/taylor-swift-patient-zero-music-video-debut-sunday-vmas |access-date=September 24, 2026 |publisher=[[CBS News]]}}</ref> The CBS and MTV telecast, along with a repeat airing on MTV, drew 8.43&nbsp;million viewers in the United States, excluding streaming, the most-watched since [[2015 MTV Video Music Awards|2015]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Schneider |first=Michael |date=September 28, 2026 |title=CBS and MTV VMAs Attract a Combined 8.4 Million Viewers, Making it the Most-Watched Since 2015 and Up 51% From Last Year |url=https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/vma-ratings-cbs-mtv-most-watched-since-2015-up-last-year-1236877733/ |access-date=September 28, 2026 |website=Variety}}</ref>

== Performances ==
On September 16, 2026, [[Madonna]] was announced as opening performer, her first performance at the VMAs in 23 years.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Petski |first=Denise |date=September 16, 2026 |title=Madonna To Open 2026 VMAs, Her First Live Performance At Show In 23 Years |url=https://deadline.com/2026/09/madonna-2026-vmas-open-performance-1237105262/ |access-date=September 16, 2026 |website=[[Deadline Hollywood]] }}</ref> The first round of performers were announced on September 17.<ref>{{Cite magazine |last=Grow |first=Kory |date=September 17, 2026 |title=Lisa, Shaboozey, Gunna Join 2026 VMAs Performers Lineup |url=https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/lisa-shaboozey-gunna-mtv-video-music-awards-performers-1235628383/ |access-date=September 17, 2026 |magazine=[[Rolling Stone]]}}</ref> The performers for the [[George Michael]] tribute were announced on September 22.<ref>{{cite magazine |last1=Halperin |first1=Shirley |last2=Legaspi |first2=Althea |title=MTV VMAs to Feature a George Michael Tribute With Raye, Sombr, and Teddy Swims |url=https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/george-michael-tribute-raye-sombr-teddy-swims-mtv-vmas-2026-1235628525/ |magazine=Rolling Stone |access-date=September 22, 2026 |date=September 22, 2026}}</ref> A tribute to [[Dolly Parton]] by [[Kacey Musgraves]] was announced on September 23.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Nolfi |first=Joey |date=September 23, 2026 |title=2026 MTV VMAs sets Dolly Parton tribute performed by Kacey Musgraves |url=https://ew.com/mtv-vmas-dolly-parton-tribute-kacey-musgraves-12136789 |access-date=September 23, 2026 |website=[[Entertainment Weekly]]}}</ref>

== Presenters ==
Presenters were announced on September 24, 2026.<ref>{{Cite web |last=DeSantis |first=Rachel |date=September 24, 2026 |title=MTV VMAs 2026 Presenters: Ciara Miller, Off Campus Stars, Charli xcx and More |url=https://people.com/mtv-vmas-2026-presenters-ciara-miller-off-campus-stars-charli-xcx-and-more-12138874 |access-date=September 24, 2026 |website=[[People (magazine)|People]]}}</ref> Additional presenters were announced on September 26, 2026.<ref>{{cite web |title=Video Music Awards (@vmas) on X |url=https://x.com/vmas/status/2103922827468624060 |website=X (formerly Twitter) |access-date=27 September 2026 |date=26 September 2026}}</ref>

* [[Teyana Taylor]] – presented Best Pop
* [[Paris Hilton]] – introduced [[Bruno Mars]]
* [[Ciara Miller]] – introduced [[Shaboozey]] and [[Gunna (rapper)|Gunna]]
* [[Isabel May]] and [[David Corenswet]] – presented Best Collaboration
* [[Tyla]] – introduced [[Lisa (rapper)|Lisa]]
* [[Chuck D]] – presented the [[Michael Jackson Video Vanguard Award|Video Vanguard Award]] to Nirvana 
* [[Rachel Dratch]] and [[Emma Bunton]] – presented Artist of the Year
* [[Ella Bright]] and [[Belmont Cameli]] – introduced [[Sienna Spiro]]
* [[Dakota Johnson]] – presented the MTV VMA Artist Director Honors
* [[Charli XCX]] and [[Troye Sivan]] – presented Best Dance
* [[Orville Peck]] – introduced the George Michael tribute
* [[Alex Warren]] – presented Best New Artist
* [[Brandon Sklenar]] and [[Jeff Probst]] – introduced [[Surkin|Gener8ion]] and [[Yung Lean]]
* [[Snoop Dogg]] (host) – presented Video of the Year

== Winners and nominees ==<!--THE ORDER OF THE CATEGORIES FOLLOWS THE WEBSITE: https://vote.mtv.com/-->
The nominees were announced on August 18, 2026.<ref>{{Cite magazine |last=Grein |first=Paul |date=August 18, 2026 |title=Madonna Leads 2026 MTV VMA Nominations: Full List |url=https://www.billboard.com/lists/2026-mtv-vma-nominations-list-madonna-video-music-awards/ |access-date=August 18, 2026 |magazine=[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]]}}</ref> The nominees in the social categories–Best Group, Best Long Form Video, Best Album and Song of Summer–were announced on September 18, with additional nominees for Best Album announced on the next day.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Grein |first=Paul |date=September 18, 2026 |title=Madonna, BTS & More Receive 2026 VMAs Nominations in Social Categories: Full List |url=https://www.billboard.com/lists/2026-mtv-vmas-nominations-social-categories-list/ |access-date=September 18, 2026 |website=Billboard}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=InMusic |title=MTV VMAs Add Ella Langley, Bruno Mars and Harry Styles to Best Album |url=https://inmusicblog.com/news/mtv-vmas-2026-best-album-new-nominees/ |website=InMusic |access-date=September 19, 2026 |date=September 19, 2026}}</ref>
[[Madonna]] led with thirteen nominations, tying [[Lady Gaga]]{{'s}} [[2010 MTV Video Music Awards|2010]] record for the most nominations for an artist in a single year.<ref>{{cite web|last=Romano|first=Andrew|date=September 24, 2026|url=https://www.yahoo.com/entertainment/music/article/madonna-is-the-most-nominated-artist-at-this-years-vmas-no-one-has-ever-made-a-comeback-quite-like-this-154442697.html|title=Madonna is the most-nominated artist at this year's VMAs. No one has ever made a comeback quite like this|access-date=September 25, 2026|work=[[Yahoo! Entertainment]]|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260925145612/https://www.yahoo.com/entertainment/music/article/madonna-is-the-most-nominated-artist-at-this-years-vmas-no-one-has-ever-made-a-comeback-quite-like-this-154442697.html|archive-date=September 25, 2026|url-status=live}}</ref> She is followed by [[Taylor Swift]] with eleven; [[Sabrina Carpenter]] with nine; [[Ariana Grande]] with eight; [[Bruno Mars]] with seven; [[Ella Langley]], [[PinkPantheress]], and [[Zara Larsson]] with five; and [[Charli XCX]], [[Gener8ion]], [[Katseye]], [[Lisa (rapper)|Lisa]], [[Olivia Rodrigo]], and [[Yung Lean]] with four.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Sherman |first=Maria |date=August 18, 2026 |title=MTV VMAs nominations: Madonna leads with 11 as Taylor Swift follows behind |url=https://www.the-independent.com/arts-entertainment/music/mtv-vmas-nominations-madonna-taylor-swift-b3034961.html |access-date=August 18, 2026 |newspaper=[[The Independent]]}}</ref>

Winners are listed first and highlighted in '''bold'''.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Mickles |first=Kiana |date=2026-09-28 |title=MTV VMAs 2026 Winners: See the Full List Here |url=https://pitchfork.com/story/mtv-vmas-2026-winners-see-the-full-list-here/ |access-date=2026-09-28 |website=Pitchfork |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-09-27 |title=All the Winners at the 2026 MTV VMAs |url=https://www.vogue.com/live/all-the-winners-2026-vmas |access-date=2026-09-28 |website=Vogue}}</ref>

=== Special awards ===
The recipient of the [[Michael Jackson Video Vanguard Award|Video Vanguard]] was announced on September 9, 2026.<ref>{{cite magazine |last=Suskind |first=Alex |date=September 9, 2026 |title=Nirvana to Receive Video Vanguard Award at 2026 VMAs |url=https://pitchfork.com/story/mtv-vmas-nirvana-to-receive-2026-video-vanguard-award/ |magazine=[[Pitchfork (website)|Pitchfork]] |access-date=September 9, 2026}}</ref> The recipient of the inaugural MTV VMA Artist Director Honors was announced on September 21.<ref>{{Cite magazine |last=Perez |first=Lexy |date=September 21, 2026 |title=Taylor Swift to Receive Inaugural MTV VMA Artist Director Honors |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/music/music-news/2026-vmas-taylor-swift-artist-director-honors-1236706910/ |access-date=September 21, 2026 |magazine=[[The Hollywood Reporter]]}}</ref>

* '''[[Michael Jackson Video Vanguard Award|Video Vanguard Award]]:''' [[Nirvana (band)|Nirvana]]
